decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Certificate of Lawful Use Granted

The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 23 January 2007, the proposed demolition of the existing rear extension and erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house and proposed installation of 4 rooflights (2 on each flank roof slope), rear roof window and glazed side loft extension was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A (The enlargement, improvement or other alteration of a dwellinghouse), B (The enlargement of a dwellinghouse consisting of an addition or alteration to its roof) and C (Any other alteration to the roof of a dwellinghouse) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 in that, for example, no part of the dwellinghouse would, as a result of the works, front on to any highway nor exceed the height of the highest part of the existing roof and because the cubic content of the roof extension is less than the 50m3 permitted development limit for a semi-detached house not in a conservation area, with the total extensions less than 70m3.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the demolition of the existing rear extension and erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house. Installation of a 4 rooflights, rear roof window and glazed side loft extension
